# cedoscript-ide

> VS Code and JetBrains support for CedoScript, the JavaScript scripting of the Tenacity Minecraft client.

- [README](README.md): features and install
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): how the repository fits together
- [Typings](typings/cedoscript.d.ts): every global, event and object
- [Capabilities](typings/capabilities.json): which members need which capability
- [VS Code extension](vscode/src/extension.ts)
- [JetBrains plugin](intellij/src/main/resources/META-INF/plugin.xml)
- [Scripting docs](https://tenacity.rip/docs)
